status.description: Status is the current status of the Device.

Device.title: Device
Device.description: Device is the Cluster's representation of a User's machine. A Device is optionally registered/enrolled by a logged-in User and it belongs to the one User that registered it. One or more of the User's Sessions can belong to the same Device. It is up to the access control Policies to allow or deny a request based on the Device's information.

id.description: ID is the stable identifier of the Probe. It is unique within the Probes list.

ownerRef.description: OwnerRef is the reference of the DeviceManager that owns the Probe

osTypes.title: OS Type
osTypes.description: OSType is the operating system of the Device

requireElevation.description: RequireElevation requires the Probe to be run with elevated privileges

condition.description: Condition decides whether the Probe is run on a given Device. Its input contains `ctx.device` and `ctx.user`. A Probe without a Condition is run on every Device.

runCommand.description: RunCommand runs a command on the Device

readFile.description: ReadFile reads a file from the Device

readRegistry.description: ReadRegistry reads a value from the Device's Windows registry

platformIdentifier.description: PlatformIdentifier reads a platform identifier of the Device

octelium.api.main.core.v1.ClusterConfig..title: Probe
octelium.api.main.core.v1.ClusterConfig..description: Probe is a check that is run on the Devices in order to collect the information used to bind them to their DeviceManagers

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Kind is the kind of the identifier

octelium.api.main.core.v1.ClusterConfig..title: Platform Identifier
octelium.api.main.core.v1.ClusterConfig..description: PlatformIdentifier reads an identifier of the Device natively from its platform without running any command

path.description: Path is the absolute path of the file to be read

maxBytes.description: MaxBytes is the maximum size in bytes that is read from the file

octelium.api.main.core.v1.ClusterConfig..title: Read File
octelium.api.main.core.v1.ClusterConfig..description: ReadFile reads a file from the Device

key.description: Key is the registry key to be read

name.description: Name is the name of the registry value to be read

octelium.api.main.core.v1.ClusterConfig..title: Read Registry
octelium.api.main.core.v1.ClusterConfig..description: ReadRegistry reads a value from the Windows registry of the Device

command.description: Command is the absolute path of the command to be run

args.description: Args is the list of the command's arguments

timeoutSeconds.description: TimeoutSeconds is the number of seconds after which running the command times out

maxOutputBytes.description: MaxOutputBytes is the maximum size in bytes of the collected output

octelium.api.main.core.v1.ClusterConfig..title: Run Command
octelium.api.main.core.v1.ClusterConfig..description: RunCommand runs a command on the Device and collects its output

match.description: Match contains a single CEL expression

all.description: All acts as a logical AND operator on its list of CEL expressions

any.description: Any acts as a logical OR operator on its list of CEL expressions

not.description: Not acts as a logical NOT operator of a single CEL expression

none.description: None acts as a logical NOR operator on its list of CEL expressions (i.e. none of the expressions matches)

opa.description: OPA contains an OPA (Open Policy Agent) Rego script

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.title: Condition
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.description: Condition is a policy-as-code expression that is evaluated against the request context. It is used by the Policy rules, the Service dynamic configuration rules, the HTTP Plugins as well as by the IdentityProvider rules.

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions that must all match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.All.title: All
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.All.description: All acts as a logical AND operator on its list of Conditions

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions of which at least one must match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.Any.title: Any
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.Any.description: Any acts as a logical OR operator on its list of Conditions

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions of which none must match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.None.title: None
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.None.description: None acts as a logical NOR operator on its list of Conditions

inline.description: Inline is the OPA Rego script directly provided as a string

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.OPA.title: OPA
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.OPA.description: OPA evaluates the Condition via an Open Policy Agent Rego script

state.title: State
state.description: State is the state of the Device

policies.description: Policies is the list of standalone Policies

inlinePolicies.description: InlinePolicies is the list of inline Policies

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Spec.Au.title: Authorization
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Spec.Au.description: Authorization sets the Policies that are applied to the Sessions belonging to the Device

ext.description: Ext is a map of internal Cluster-managed extension data

userRef.description: UserRef is a reference to the owner User

osType.title: OS Type
osType.description: OSType is the operating system of the Device

id.description: ID is a unique Device identifier that is derived from the Device's host

serialNumber.description: SerialNumber is the Device's hardware serial number reported by the client at registration. It is not a verified identity.

isLocked.description: IsLocked indicates whether the Device is locked by the Cluster

macAddresses.description: MacAddresses is the list of the MAC addresses of the Device's network interfaces reported by the client at registration. They are not a verified identity.

posture.description: Posture is the last posture collected from the bound DeviceManager. In the authorization context, it is only exposed while the Binding is ACCEPTED and VALID and the Posture has not expired. Otherwise, it is omitted so that CEL expressions do not need to check these conditions.

binding.description: Binding is the Device's link to its single authoritative DeviceManager

probeAttempt.description: ProbeAttempt is the most recent device probing attempt

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status.title: Status
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status.description: Status is the current status of the Device

uid.description: UID is the unique identifier of the Binding. Resetting the Binding or selecting another DeviceManager or inventory entry creates a new UID.

ownerRef.description: OwnerRef is the reference of the DeviceManager of the Binding

externalID.description: ExternalID is the identifier of the inventory entry in the DeviceManager's provider

state.title: State
state.description: State is the state of the Binding

validity.title: Validity
validity.description: Validity is whether an ACCEPTED Binding is currently usable

reason.description: Reason is a machine-readable reason of the current State and Validity

message.description: Message is a human-readable message that explains Reason

acceptedAt.description: AcceptedAt is the timestamp at which the Binding was accepted

lastVerifiedAt.description: LastVerifiedAt is the timestamp at which the Binding was last verified

nextVerificationAt.description: NextVerificationAt is the timestamp after which the Device is probed again to verify the Binding

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status..title: Binding
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status..description: Binding is the Device's link to one inventory entry of its single authoritative DeviceManager. An ACCEPTED Binding is kept through provider outages until it is explicitly reset or its DeviceManager is deleted. A Binding that is not VALID makes the Posture unavailable; it never causes a fallback to another DeviceManager.

riskLevel.title: Risk Level
riskLevel.description: RiskLevel is the overall risk level of the Device as assessed by the provider itself

diskEncryption.title: Signal State
diskEncryption.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

compliant.title: Signal State
compliant.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

threatFree.title: Signal State
threatFree.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

additionalProperties.title: Signal State
additionalProperties.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

signals.description: Signals contains additional provider-specific signals keyed by `x.<provider>.<name>`. Signals that have a dedicated field are never duplicated in this map.

lastSyncAt.description: LastSyncAt is the timestamp at which the Posture was last synced from the provider

lastSeenAt.description: LastSeenAt is the timestamp at which the Device was last seen by the provider

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt is the timestamp after which the Posture is no longer valid. The Cluster evaluates it using its own clock. It is never later than the expiry of the oldest provider observation represented by the Posture, so polling does not refresh the lifetime of an old observation.

attrs.description: Attrs is a map of the additional provider-specific attributes of the Device

firewall.title: Signal State
firewall.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

screenLock.title: Signal State
screenLock.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

secureBoot.title: Signal State
secureBoot.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

osUpToDate.title: Signal State
osUpToDate.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

agentHealthy.title: Signal State
agentHealthy.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

enrolled.title: Signal State
enrolled.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

notContained.title: Signal State
notContained.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

mobileIntegrity.title: Signal State
mobileIntegrity.description: SignalState is the state of a posture signal

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status..title: Posture
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status..description: Posture is the security posture reported by the Device's bound DeviceManager. Common signals have dedicated fields for use in CEL. A signal is satisfied only when its state is PASS; unknown and inapplicable signals do not satisfy a posture requirement.

uid.description: UID is the unique identifier of the ProbeAttempt

startedAt.description: StartedAt is the timestamp at which the ProbeAttempt started

probes.description: Probes is the list of the Probes that were issued to the Device

results.description: Results is the list of the Results of the issued Probes

state.title: State
state.description: State is the state of the ProbeAttempt

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt is the timestamp after which the ProbeAttempt can no longer be completed. The Cluster evaluates it using its own clock.

submittedAt.description: SubmittedAt is the timestamp at which the Results were submitted

sessionRef.description: SessionRef is a reference to the Session that started the ProbeAttempt

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status..title: Probe Attempt
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status..description: ProbeAttempt is the most recent attempt to run the Cluster's Probes on the Device to collect evidence for selecting or verifying its Binding

probeID.description: ProbeID is the ID of the Probe that produced the Result

status.title: Status
status.description: Status is the outcome of running the Probe

list.description: List is a list of values

isTruncated.description: IsTruncated indicates whether the value was truncated

exitCode.description: ExitCode is the exit code of a RunCommand Probe

detail.description: Detail is a human-readable detail of the Status

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status..title: Result
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status..description: Result is the result of running a single Probe

items.description: Items is the list of values

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status..title: List
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Device.Status..description: List is a list of values

name.description: Name is the name of the inline Policy

octelium.api.main.core.v1.InlinePolicy.title: Inline Policy
octelium.api.main.core.v1.InlinePolicy.description: InlinePolicy is a Policy that is defined inline within the resource that attaches it instead of being created as a standalone Policy resource.

rules.description: Rules is the list of Policy rules

enforcementRules.description: EnforcementRules is the list of enforcement rules that are typically used as a precondition for using the Policy rules. You can simply extract your shared conditions from your rules and write them instead inside enforcementRules for better performance and readability

attrs.description: Attrs is a map of user-defined attributes that can be reused inside the Policy rules. It is strongly recommended to stick to camelCase in order to be conformant with Octelium's API naming conventions.

isDisabled.description: IsDisabled disables (i.e. deactivates) the Policy. You can use this to temporarily disable enforcing the Policy altogether instead of having to delete it or de-attach it from the different Resources attaching it.

condition.description: Condition is the enforcement rule's Condition

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect is the decision of the EnforcementRule once its Condition matches

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.En.title: Enforcement Rule
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.En.description: EnforcementRule is a pre-condition that decides whether the Policy is evaluated at all. If no EnforcementRule matches, or if the list of EnforcementRules is empty, then the Policy is enforced. ENFORCE rules always override IGNORE rules in the same way that DENY rules override ALLOW rules.

name.description: Name is an optional name for the rule. It is currently useful in Logs to understand which rule triggered the Policy.

condition.description: Condition is the rule's Condition that must match in order for the rule, and subsequently the Policy as whole, to match

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect is the decision of the Rule once its Condition matches

priority.description: Priority is an integer that sets the rule priority level. The lower the number, the higher the priority. Currently the range of numbers is between -4 (i.e. the highest priority) and 4 (i.e. the lowest priority).

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.Ru.title: Rule
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.Ru.description: Rule is a single access control rule of the Policy

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
